escenas.texto: This week in Asia, millions of people watched, commented and shared non-stop. The thirty videos in this countdown add up to over five hundred and nineteen million views. But only one took number one. Welcome to Top 10 Social Media, Asia edition. Today: the ten most viewed, the ten most commented and the ten most liked videos of the week. Stay until the end, because you won't guess number one.

The rules, quick and clear. Only videos posted in the last seven days that trended in Asia. One video per creator on each list. Music and news have their own space. Every number comes from the official YouTube API, with the weekly cut every Wednesday at midnight, Lima, Peru time. Let's go.

Let's start with the ten most viewed videos. In position number ten, from India, FactTechz, with a video posted four days ago. Over sixteen million views. A Short of just fifty-six seconds. It also has over two thousand comments.
Number nine, from India, Paintellectual PriyA, with a video posted five days ago. Over sixteen million views. A Short of just thirty-five seconds. It also has eight hundred and three comments.
Number eight, from South Korea, P1Harmony, with a video posted five days ago. Over eighteen million views. It also has over four thousand comments.

Number seven, LucaaaFilms, with “My travel-style shots at home”. Over eighteen million views. And get this: it's a channel with about ten thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week. A Short of just twenty-four seconds.

Coming in at number six, from India, Baccha Mat Bolna, with a video posted six days ago. Over nineteen million views. It has the best engagement rate on this list: two out of every hundred viewers liked or commented. It also has over one thousand comments.

Coming in at number five, from Japan, IORI GAME ROOM, with a video posted two days ago. Over twenty-two million views. And get this: it's a channel with about one hundred and thirty thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week. A Short of just fifty-five seconds.
At number four, from Indonesia, Keizo & Friends, with a video posted six days ago. Over twenty-two million views. A Short of just thirty-one seconds. It also has forty-four comments.

Bronze medal, from Georgia, Denis Shmalts, with “How the First Combat Submarine Actually Worked”. Over twenty-seven million views. A Short of just thirty-four seconds. It also has over two thousand comments.
Silver medal, from India, Sharmi’s Creation , with a video posted five days ago. Over thirty million views. A Short of just thirty-two seconds. It also has three hundred and ninety-six comments.

And here it is. Number one most viewed, from India, Thar Desert Photography, with a video posted four days ago. Over seventy-two million views. It was the fastest-growing video on this list: about six hundred and fifty thousand views per hour. A Short of just twenty-five seconds.

Now for the conversation: the ten most commented videos. At number ten, from South Korea, SHIFT UP Official Channel, with “Stellar Blade - Live Action Launch Trailer - Nintendo Switch 2”. Over seven thousand comments. And get this: it's a channel with about forty-seven thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week. It also has over three point six million views.

Number nine, from Japan, ふぉ〜ゆ〜ちゅ〜ぶ, with a video posted one day ago. Over eight thousand comments. It has the best engagement rate on this list: fifteen out of every hundred viewers liked or commented. It got there in just one day.

At number eight, from India, ProBoiz 95, with “I Can Turn Any BLOCK into GUN in Minecraft!”. Over eight thousand comments. A video over thirty-one minutes long, and people still stayed to watch. It got there in just two days.
Next up, number seven, Zack D. Films, with “What If Bug-Man Grew Inside Purple Guy”. Over nine thousand comments. A Short of just fifty-two seconds. It also has over thirteen million views.
Next up, number six, from India, Shivang Mini, with a video posted one day ago. Over ten thousand comments. It got there in just one day. It also has over five hundred and six thousand views.

Coming in at number five, from India, Kalaippuli S Thanu, with a video posted two days ago. Over sixteen thousand comments. It got there in just two days. It also has over five point five million views.

Next up, number four, from India, YesSmartyPie, with a video posted three days ago. Over eighteen thousand comments. A video over eighty minutes long, and people still stayed to watch. It also has over one point three million views.

Bronze medal, from India, Salman Khan Films, with a video posted one day ago. Over eighteen thousand comments. It was the fastest-growing video on this list: about seven hundred and sixty thousand views per hour. It got there in just one day.

Silver medal, from Indonesia, Nadia Omara, with a video posted five days ago. Over nineteen thousand comments. A video over thirty-three minutes long, and people still stayed to watch. It also has over fifteen million views.
And finally, number one most commented, from Indonesia, Dhot Design, with a video posted six days ago. Over seventy-three thousand comments. It also has over eleven million views.

And the last list: the ten most liked videos. Coming in at number ten, from Indonesia, Nadia Omara, with a video posted five days ago. Over three hundred and thirteen thousand likes. A video over thirty-three minutes long, and people still stayed to watch. It also has over fifteen million views.
Number nine, from India, Fact2Fact, with a video posted six days ago. Over three hundred and sixteen thousand likes. It also has over nine million views.
Coming in at number eight, from South Korea, minday (Tok Tok Tok), with “thank you”. Over three hundred and twenty-five thousand likes. It also has over five point five million views.

Next up, number seven, LucaaaFilms, with “My travel-style shots at home”. Over three hundred and twenty-nine thousand likes. And get this: it's a channel with about ten thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week. A Short of just twenty-four seconds.
Number six, from India, FactTechz, with a video posted four days ago. Over three hundred and forty-eight thousand likes. A Short of just fifty-six seconds. It also has over sixteen million views.

At number five, from Singapore, Lil Resumen, with a video posted two days ago. Over three hundred and sixty-three thousand likes. It has the best engagement rate on this list: six out of every hundred viewers liked or commented. It got there in just two days.
Number four, from India, Facts' Mine, with “Last Words Of Lady Pilot”. Over four hundred and fifteen thousand likes. It also has over ten million views.
Bronze medal, from India, Baccha Mat Bolna, with a video posted six days ago. Over four hundred and twenty-five thousand likes. It also has over nineteen million views.

Silver medal, from India, Thar Desert Photography, with a video posted four days ago. Over four hundred and forty-one thousand likes. It was the fastest-growing video on this list: about six hundred and fifty thousand views per hour. A Short of just twenty-five seconds.

And finally, number one most liked, Zack D. Films, with “What If Bug-Man Grew Inside Purple Guy”. Over five hundred and thirty-three thousand likes. A Short of just fifty-two seconds. It also has over thirteen million views.

And the world tour isn't over. Next stop: Africa. The link is in the description and in the playlist. Now it's your turn: which video should have made this countdown? Tell us in the comments with the hashtag Top10RS. Links to every original video are in the description: go support the creators. Subscribe and hit the bell, so you're the first to know the winners in Asia every Sunday. And watch out: the top three of each list move on to the global ranking. Next week, that video could be yours. And a question for you: do you want us to hold a real award for the Top 10 winners? If you do, write the hashtag Premios Top 10 RS in the comments, all in one word.
